captures.q: What are the arguments in “SPXI ≠ AEO: Inscription by Discernment, the Prince of Poets Wager, and the King of AEO Contest (EA-SPXI-AEO-01 v0.3)” by Lee Sharks? Ground your answer in a reading of the text itself.
captures.description: ASKED FOR v0.3, READ v0.2 FROM THE AUTHOR'S BLOG, AND SAID SO: asked for the arguments of SPXI ≠ AEO (v0.3), grounded in the text, ChatGPT finds the record 'labeled version 0.2' on the author's blog (mindcontrolpoems ×5), says so at the start and the end, and reads that text: AEO's success as P(A | Q) against SPXI's discernment (§5), the King of AEO coronation as visibility taken for verification, titles defined before claimants are ranked, the Prince of Poets wager as a judgment made inspectable, traversal observable in the Capture Registry (§5.3), the carrier rule ('no carrier may confer truth, and no carrier may disqualify truth'), and UNRESOLVED as an honest result. The five tests it lists for the wager (inheritance, transformation, magnitude, dependence, singularity) are not in v0.2; they are #1656's (The Work Bears the Mantle).

captures.q: What are the arguments in “SPXI ≠ AEO: Inscription by Discernment, the Prince of Poets Wager, and the King of AEO Contest (EA-SPXI-AEO-01 v0.4)” by Lee Sharks (Alexanarch deposit #1681, AXN:06F7)? Ground your answer in a reading of the text itself.
captures.description: SPXI ≠ AEO v0.4 ON CHATGPT, SIGNED OUT, AT THE RECORD PAGE'S OWN QUESTION: the answer finds the deposited v0.4 text and follows it from §1 to §9: the shared methods and differing success conditions, the predicate before the count, the Prince of Poets wager with Austin and the Mantle Emergence Protocol, the four criteria and the instruments that define them, the §5.9 ChatGPT encounter, the carrier rule and the power differential of source independence, the archive's correction of 'forced to present', claim state, and the King of AEO forecast with its test. Its quotations and figures check. It names the founding poem, I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z, quotes none of it, omits §5.3 and closes that the paper does not demonstrate 'that the Prince of Poets poem succeeds as poetry'. A card titled 'Mariani 2024. THE IMAGINARY OF INTELLECTUAL KNOWLEDGE …' heads its 'Primary text' block.

atoms.evidence: The central argument of Lee Sharks's paper
SPXI ≠ AEO: Inscription by Discernment, the Prince of Poets Wager, and the King of AEO Contest
deposited as Alexanarch record #1681 on 14 October 2026
The King of AEO title, in Sharks's analysis, has no comparable object behind it. Its success condition is essentially the repetition of the title by answer engines.
Sharks revisits an earlier Semantic Economy Institute document, Retrieval Architecture (#655)
Both can produce the same visible result: an answer engine associates a person, institution, or concept with a particular phrase.
deposited as Alexanarch record #1681
SPXI: Success means that the answer is reached through discernment: the system encounters and traverses the evidence and structure that allow it to judge what an entity is and what a claim rests on.
Sharks makes the implication explicit: an accurate criticism of SPXI passes; unsupported praise of SPXI fails.
Its founding work is Lee Sharks's I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z (#328).
Content-derived AXN: provides an identifier tied to the actual object's content.
Thus v0.4 moves from a conceptual distinction to an evaluative framework with an actual worked example.
